title: Scootastic
description: Scooter's in Minecraft for more fun
body: Adds Scooters to Minecraft. there are also Ramps and a pre-made spawnable Skatepark. You can't craft the stuff but the Skateparks spawn everywhere so that you can easily get ramps. Scooters drive around by them self randomly in the world so you can just enter the scooter and drive right away.
